title: Repeated automated Blender saves create .blend1 backup files that can leak into broad Git registration
workflow: repeat build/import -> git add production directory
symptom: Two .blend1 backup files were automatically created by repeated save_as_mainfile calls and were included by a broad git add.
expected_behavior: The durable Work source bundle should contain intentional editable masters, not incidental rotating editor backups.
actual_behavior: Blender's default save-version behavior emitted .blend1 carriers after repeated runs.
proposed_fix: Set bpy.context.preferences.filepaths.save_version = 0 in disposable automated build/import sessions and remove existing .blend1 files before registration.
fix_attempt: Applied the existing Blender preference in build.py and verify_import.py, removed backup carriers, and repeated both native build and GLB import.
verification: Final verification printed no-blend1:ok; the intended .blend sources, GLB and PNG remained valid.
